WITH kind AS (SELECT product_kind_id FROM product_kinds WHERE product_kind_name = :kind_name), family AS (SELECT product_family_id FROM product_families WHERE brand = :brand AND product_family_name = :family_name) SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path FROM product_variants v JOIN kind k ON v.product_kind_id = k.product_kind_id JOIN family f ON v.product_family_id = f.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties p ON v.product_sku = p.product_sku WHERE p.property_key = :prop_key AND p.property_value_text = :prop_value LIMIT 1;
